notes: Cognitive walkthrough (full four-question variant) of journey change-slot at 375 px, light theme. Record: cw/change-slot.json. 5 steps walked; steps 2 (CW-Q4) and 4 (CW-Q2) failed; journey verdict would_with_effort. All candidates are E0 hypotheses.

task_suitability.task: change-slot: move Saturday 17 October 09:20 to 14:20 and return to Check and book

strengths.evidence: probes/8/final.png; probes/8/aria.yml: Slot 14:20 to 14:40, Vehicle Car, Waste Garden waste, Wood

candidates.title: Change slot opens a fresh 'Book a slot' page with no sign of the booking being changed
candidates.description: When a resident changes one part of a booking in progress, the next screen should show that this is a change to that booking: the current day and slot selected, and a sign that the vehicle and waste are kept. After tapping 'Change slot' on Check and book (Saturday 17 October, 09:20, car, garden waste and wood), the page shown is the start of a new booking: H1 'Book a slot' with the new-booking intro, 'Today' pressed rather than Saturday 17, no slot selected, an empty Slots area, and no mention of the existing day, slot, vehicle or waste. The URL is /index.html with no parameters.
candidates.impact: Residents changing a booking do not know whether changing keeps the rest of the booking; this screen may lead them to believe the booking was discarded, so they may back out, re-enter the vehicle and waste, or abandon the change.

evidence.detail: click Change slot -> final_url /index.html; H1 'Book a slot'; 'Today' pressed; Slots region empty
no text naming Saturday 17, 09:20, Car or the waste on the page

factor_notes.frequency: Every use of Change slot from Check and book; changing a slot is a core top task.
factor_notes.impact: Step 2 verdict would_with_effort: the flow does in fact keep vehicle and waste (seen at step 5), but nothing says so until the resident reaches Check and book again.
factor_notes.persistence: Recurs on each change; the resident only learns the rest was kept after completing the change.

candidates.recommendation: On the slot page reached from Change slot, preselect the booking's day and slot, title it as a change (for example 'Change your slot'), and state that the vehicle and waste stay as they are; offer a way back to Check and book without changing.

candidates.title: 'Few left' slots appear above the Morning heading, out of time order
candidates.description: A day's slots should read in time order under their Morning and Afternoon headings, so a resident looking for a particular time knows where it will be. On Saturday 17 at 375 px the list opens with an unheaded block of ten 'Few left' slots that mixes morning and afternoon (08:20 ... 10:40, then 13:40, 14:00, 15:00, 16:40), followed by 'Morning' and then 'Afternoon'. 14:20 is absent from the first block and appears only under 'Afternoon', after scrolling past the morning slots.
candidates.impact: A resident moving to 'the afternoon' may read the gap between 14:00 and 15:00 in the first block as 14:20 being unavailable and pick a different time, or spend extra scrolling on a phone to find it.

evidence.detail: full-page capture: Few-left block above 'Morning'; 14:20 under 'Afternoon'
group 'Slots': 10 'Few left' buttons precede heading 'Morning'; button '14:20' follows heading 'Afternoon'

factor_notes.frequency: Any day with some slots marked 'Few left'; affects both booking and changing a slot.
factor_notes.impact: Step 4 verdict would_with_effort; recoverable by scrolling.
factor_notes.persistence: Order depends on availability, so the position of a given time shifts between days and visits.

candidates.recommendation: Keep every slot in time order under Morning and Afternoon and show 'Few left' as a tag on the slot in place.
